basis.prefix: The harness builds three InmemTransports (A, B, C) in a full mesh with per-node InmemStore and InmemCommitTrackingStore; node A's snapshot store is a wrapper that delegates List and Open to an InmemSnapshotStore and fails Create once its flag is set, while B and C use plain in-memory snapshot stores. It bootstraps {A,B,C} from A with Config.RestoreCommittedLogs enabled, starts the three nodes with MockFSM, A configured with SnapshotInterval 100ms and SnapshotThreshold 1000, waits for a leader and transfers leadership to B if another node won. It applies five commands, waits until A has applied at least four entries, takes the early snapshot on A, then enables the failure flag so every later Create on A fails. It applies 8300 further commands, waits until A's staged commit index is at least 8200 above the early snapshot index, and emits 'fixture' with the snapshot index, staged commit index, log last index, entries to replay, expected batches, MaxAppendEntries, the gap flag, the number of failed Create attempts, whether failures were tolerated, the cluster ids and the leader.
